name: mla_prefill_flydsl_fp8_attention
changes: With VLLM_ROCM_MLA_PREFILL_FLYDSL_FP8=1 (Prefill only), ROCM_AITER_FA MLA prefill quantizes Q/K/V to FP8 per tensor (dynamic) and runs AITER FlyDSL flydsl_flash_attn_fp8_func for new tokens (causal) and context chunks (cross, LSE); BF16 fallback when unsupported. Same kernel ATOM 6611 uses via ATOM_USE_FLYDSL_FP8_PREFILL_ATTN=1

K/V use two-pass Triton fused_kv_per_tensor_quant without a per-row atomic reduction. NK/NV/WORKERS are runtime arguments; PARTS/BLOCK/SINGLE_PASS remain compile-time variants. Backend source is identical to complete unprofiled Slurm 9091.

source_reference.composition: CPUFA manager d3e3dd53 is retained; the FQ reference used CPUREF2 manager 76e038dc. Combined performance is untested.
